|notes=The set was released 21 November 2003. The complete first sheet remains unlocated. The comparison dates each surviving issuer text. [https://web.archive.org/web/20031202154611id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm Players Committee release announcement]. The remaster drops the optional 1-Force activation and retrieves the topmost eligible Lost Pile character instead of putting it into hand. It directs both the top Reserve Deck card and the combat card to Lost Pile. The Imperial Barrier restriction, senator cost and Alter immunity remain. The [[:File:CC-D-abilityabilityability-decipher-archive.gif|underlying Decipher card]] already has the title dot. 
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154341/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards6.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards6.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #32 on 14 September 2007); page 3, slip 27. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Ability, Ability, Ability]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds#Cards|Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
* Earlier versions: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040619231451/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf final revised sheet of 12 January 2004] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20050406053829/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%206.pdf revised sheet of 12 October 2004] (old pre-Remaster slips).
